t: It was said to Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him : We wish you had changed your grey hair, O Amir al-Mu'minin Then he said : Dye is a way of adornment while we are in a state of grief. Al-Sayyid al-Radi says : Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, is referring to the death of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his descendants.
